documents.question: What is NextGenPro?
variations: what is nextgenpro
tell me about nextgenpro
about nextgenpro
documents.answer: NextGenPro is an Innovation & Edupark organization based in Palarivattom, Kochi, Kerala, India. NextGenPro combines innovation-focused technology work with educational (edupark) activities, and its staff cover a wide range of specializations including administration, accounting and logistics, content creation, SEO, data science, AI and data science, data analytics, web development, mobile app development, cybersecurity, robotics, robotics and IoT, and Montessori education.
